Send Engram::Architect3 only concrete collaboration failures requiring workflow/rule correction, including failed interaction, evidence, impact and current owner; send the same report to Engram::Advisor. Routine START/PASS/FAIL, READY, repair progress and queue status go to task notes and Fable2, not Architect3. Merger2 receives only one complete READY. Never use Architect3 as a test --notify recipient, result relay or recovery owner; use Fable2/session-8112. Do not interrupt/rerun an existing gate to change routing. No reply requested.
